cards.english_title: Merz to Meet President Lee
cards.korean_desc: 독일 총리 메르츠가 10월 29~30일 한국을 방문합니다. 이 대통령과 정상회담을 하고 독일 기업 행사에도 참석합니다.
cards.english_desc: German Chancellor Merz will visit South Korea on October 29–30. He will meet President Lee and attend a German business event.
cards.hook: A first visit brings business and diplomacy together.

cards.english_title: Korea and Japan Seek Supply Chain Cooperation
cards.korean_desc: 이 대통령은 한국과 일본이 첨단산업 공급망에서 더 협력해야 한다고 말했습니다. 일본 경제인 대표단과의 만남에서 이 발언을 했습니다.
cards.english_desc: President Lee said South Korea and Japan should cooperate more on supply chains for advanced industries. He made the remarks during a meeting with Japanese business leaders.
cards.hook: Two neighbors want their high-tech supply chains to stick together.

cards.english_title: Hungary Seeks Closer Ties with Korea
cards.korean_desc: 헝가리는 한국과 투자 및 기술 협력을 강화하자고 제안했습니다. 양국이 민주주의와 인권을 중요하게 여긴다고도 말했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Hungary proposed stronger investment and technology cooperation with South Korea. It also said both countries value democracy and human rights.
cards.hook: A historic uprising inspires a modern partnership.

cards.english_title: Korea Donates Eight Helicopters to Kenya
cards.korean_desc: 한국이 정비를 마친 퇴역 군 헬리콥터 8대를 케냐에 기증했습니다. 이 헬기들은 유엔 평화유지 활동을 지원하는 데 사용됩니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea donated eight overhauled retired military helicopters to Kenya. The helicopters will support United Nations peacekeeping activities.
cards.hook: These retired helicopters are starting a surprisingly useful second career.

cards.english_title: Hana Financial Reports Record Profit
cards.korean_desc: 하나금융그룹의 올해 첫 9개월 순이익이 3조 6200억 원으로 사상 최대를 기록했습니다. 자사주 매입과 소각도 크게 늘었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Hana Financial Group posted a record net profit of 3.62 trillion won in the first nine months of the year. Its share buybacks and cancellations also increased sharply.
cards.hook: Hana’s profits are big—and shareholders noticed.

cards.english_title: Woori Financial Profit Tops One Trillion Won
cards.korean_desc: 우리금융그룹이 2분기 연속 1조 원이 넘는 분기 순이익을 올렸습니다. 올해 첫 9개월 순이익은 2조 6600억 원입니다.
cards.english_desc: Woori Financial Group posted quarterly net profit above one trillion won for the second straight quarter. Its net profit for the first nine months was 2.66 trillion won.
cards.hook: Woori keeps crossing the trillion-won line.

cards.korean_title: 서울 증시, 저가 매수로 소폭 상승
cards.english_title: Seoul Stocks Edge Up on Bargain Hunting
cards.korean_desc: 서울 증시는 전날 급락한 뒤 반도체주를 중심으로 소폭 올랐습니다. 투자자들이 저가 매수에 나섰고 원화도 강세를 보였습니다.
cards.english_desc: Seoul stocks edged higher after plunging the previous day, led by chip shares. Investors bought stocks at lower prices, and the won also strengthened.
cards.hook: After a big dip, bargain hunters went shopping.

cards.english_title: Groups Warn of Aging IT Security Risks
cards.korean_desc: 주한미국상공회의소와 시스코가 낡은 IT 시스템의 보안 위험을 경고했습니다. 한국 기업에 시스템을 현대화하라고 촉구했습니다.
cards.english_desc: The American Chamber of Commerce in Korea and Cisco warned about security risks from aging IT systems. They urged Korean companies to modernize their systems.
cards.hook: Old software may be quietly inviting new hackers.

cards.english_title: The Haunting Beauty of Deborah Turbeville
cards.korean_desc: 데버라 터빌의 사진은 흐릿하고 어두운 분위기를 보여 줍니다. 사진 속 모델들은 화려한 잡지보다 유령처럼 보입니다.
cards.english_desc: Deborah Turbeville’s photographs show a blurry, dark atmosphere. The models look more like ghosts than fashion magazine stars.
cards.hook: Her glamorous photos look like memories that forgot to smile.

cards.english_title: Justin Bieber Visits Seongsu
cards.korean_desc: 저스틴 비버가 자신의 브랜드를 홍보하기 위해 서울 성수를 찾았습니다. 그의 패션·라이프스타일 브랜드가 성수동에 첫 팝업스토어를 열었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Justin Bieber visited Seoul’s Seongsu neighborhood to promote his own brand. His fashion and lifestyle brand opened its first pop-up store there.
cards.hook: Bieber traded the stage for a Seoul storefront.

cards.korean_title: K/DA와 롤 월즈, 한국 협업 확대
cards.english_title: K/DA and LoL Worlds Expand Korean Collaborations
cards.korean_desc: 라이엇게임즈가 롤 월즈와 K/DA를 기념해 한국에서 다양한 협업을 진행합니다. 팝업스토어와 한정 상품도 선보입니다.
cards.english_desc: Riot Games is launching various Korean collaborations to celebrate LoL Worlds and K/DA. The projects include pop-up stores and limited-edition products.
cards.hook: The game is leaving the screen—and shopping is joining in.

cards.korean_title: 넷플릭스 세계 이용자 80%, 한국 콘텐츠 시청
cards.english_title: 80% of Netflix Users Watched Korean Content
cards.korean_desc: 전 세계 넷플릭스 가입자의 약 80%가 한국 영화나 드라마를 시청했습니다. 넷플릭스는 한국 서비스 10주년을 맞아 이 수치를 공개했습니다.
cards.english_desc: About 80 percent of Netflix subscribers worldwide have watched Korean films or shows. Netflix released the figure to mark ten years of service in Korea.
cards.hook: Korean stories have become everyone’s streaming neighbors.

cards.english_title: Korea to Face Saudi Arabia and Qatar
cards.korean_desc: 한국 축구대표팀이 11월에 사우디아라비아와 카타르와 평가전을 치릅니다. 두 경기는 카타르 도하에서 열립니다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea’s men’s football team will play friendly matches against Saudi Arabia and Qatar in November. Both matches will take place in Doha, Qatar.
cards.hook: Two tough friendlies will test Korea under Doha lights.

cards.english_title: Cho Eun-hye Wins Para Games Fencing Gold
cards.korean_desc: 조은혜가 여자 개인 에페 B에서 금메달을 따냈습니다. 한국은 장애인아시안게임 펜싱에서 처음으로 금메달을 획득했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Cho Eun-hye won gold in the women’s individual epee B event. South Korea earned its first Asian Para Games fencing gold medal.
cards.hook: One point made history for Korean para fencing.

cards.english_title: Oosthuizen to Leave LIV Golf
cards.korean_desc: 2010년 브리티시 오픈 우승자인 루이 오스트하우젠이 LIV 골프를 떠납니다. 그는 이번 결정이 인생에서 가장 어려운 결정 중 하나라고 말했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Louis Oosthuizen, the 2010 British Open champion, will leave LIV Golf. He said the decision was one of the hardest of his life.
cards.hook: A major champion is changing courses off the course.

cards.english_title: Bayern Draw 2-2 with Arsenal
cards.korean_desc: 바이에른 뮌헨이 아스널과 2-2로 비겼습니다. 한국 수비수 김민재는 전반전만 뛰었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Bayern Munich drew 2-2 with Arsenal. South Korean defender Kim Min-jae played only the first half.
cards.hook: A four-goal thriller ended with neither side winning.

cards.english_title: Santos Bravos Announce Anniversary Release
cards.korean_desc: 라틴 팝 그룹 산토스 브라보스가 데뷔 1주년을 맞아 11월 20일 신곡을 발표합니다. 이번 곡은 그룹의 새 음악입니다.
cards.english_desc: Latin pop group Santos Bravos will release a new song on November 20 for its first anniversary. It will be the group’s new music release.
cards.hook: One year old, and Santos Bravos already has a musical gift.

cards.english_title: Aoora Headlines Indian Festival Finale
cards.korean_desc: 한국 가수 아우라가 인도 케랄라에서 열린 음악축제의 마지막 무대를 장식했습니다. 그는 자신의 노래와 말라얄람 인기곡을 불렀습니다.
cards.english_desc: Korean singer Aoora headlined the finale of a music festival in Kerala, India. He performed his own songs and popular Malayalam songs.
cards.hook: A Korean singer gave Kerala’s finale a cross-cultural encore.

cards.english_title: A2O Soul to Release Debut EP
cards.korean_desc: 15인조 보이그룹 A2O 소울이 11월 9일 데뷔 EP ‘슈퍼스타’를 발표합니다. 앨범에는 ‘슈퍼스타’와 ‘댄싱 인 더 다크’ 등이 수록됩니다.
cards.english_desc: The 15-member boy group A2O Soul will release its debut EP, “Superstar,” on November 9. The album includes “Superstar” and “Dancing in the Dark,” among other songs.
cards.hook: Fifteen members, five tracks, and one big debut.

cards.english_title: Ian Eastwood Reconnects with Korea’s Dance Scene
cards.korean_desc: 안무가 이언 이스트우드가 한국의 연예기획사에서 연습생들을 가르쳤습니다. 그는 데뷔 전 댄서들의 재능에 깊은 인상을 받았습니다.
cards.english_desc: Choreographer Ian Eastwood taught trainees at Korean entertainment agencies. He was deeply impressed by the talent of dancers who have not debuted yet.
cards.hook: The teacher returned—and the students surprised him.

cards.korean_title: PHP 보안 결함에 해킹 시도 급증
cards.english_title: Hacking Attempts Surge After PHP Flaws Found
cards.korean_desc: 기업과 정부가 인터넷 기반 기술인 PHP의 심각한 보안 결함을 서둘러 고치고 있습니다. 결함이 공개된 뒤 해킹 시도가 크게 늘었습니다.
cards.english_desc: Companies and governments are rushing to fix serious flaws in PHP, a technology used across the internet. Hacking attempts surged after the flaws were disclosed.
cards.hook: A tiny software flaw can open a very large digital door.

cards.english_title: Overseas Korean-Language Classes Keep Growing
cards.korean_desc: 2025년 해외 한국어 수업의 학생 수가 19만 1896명에 달했습니다. 5년 전보다 약 50% 늘어난 수치입니다.
cards.english_desc: The number of students in overseas Korean-language classes reached 191,896 in 2025. That was about 50 percent higher than five years earlier.
cards.hook: Korean class enrollment is growing faster than a catchy chorus.

cards.english_title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion Privacy Penalty
cards.korean_desc: 미국 뉴멕시코 법원이 개인정보 사건에서 메타에 250억 달러를 지급하라고 명령했습니다. 배심원은 메타가 이용자들에게 개인정보 보호를 잘못 알렸다고 판단했습니다.
cards.english_desc: A New Mexico court ordered Meta to pay $25 billion in a data privacy case. A jury found that Meta misled users about protecting their personal data.
cards.hook: Privacy mistakes just received an enormous price tag.

cards.korean_title: 미 상원 승부처, 사전투표 크게 증가
cards.english_title: Early Voting Rises in Key Senate States
cards.korean_desc: 미국 상원 주도권을 결정할 가능성이 큰 여러 주에서 사전투표가 크게 늘었습니다. 텍사스에서는 2022년보다 74% 증가했습니다.
cards.english_desc: Early voting has risen sharply in several states that could decide control of the US Senate. In Texas, it is up 74 percent from 2022.
cards.hook: The Senate race is heating up before Election Day arrives.
